input.name: LoftwahFM
input.job: Find and experience worthwhile original music
tasks: Use the player from another project
input.proof: Meaningful playback and a reason to continue listening
input.publishedContext: LoftwahFM plays its music catalogue through the native station player and its versioned game-radio client. The listening companion now shows approved complete Loftwah, Pippa and Pepe figures in the player, with intentional portraits in the chooser and honest missing-art recovery. Saved character choices, Moss’s accepted appearance, station controls and optional conversation remain. These recovered stills do not add authored expression sets.

input.name: Bubbles
input.job: Get into a satisfying quick round
tasks: Recognise Bubblecap and the game’s identity
input.proof: A real phone round with clear shot, feedback and restart
input.publishedContext: Fewest Shots is live as a second competitive mode: one board, no shot limit, cleared in as few shots as possible. Submitted runs are replayed on the server to derive the result, so a record cannot come from a browser's unverified claim, and a genuine long clear stays eligible. The same work corrected an advertised 30-shot objective that did not match the real scoring. The live build also carries the promoted Bubblecap mascot and reworked presentation from the same window.

input.name: Fighter
input.job: Understand and enjoy a squad battle
tasks: Understand the outcome of a move
Find a mode worth returning to
input.proof: A full match where you can explain the decisions that mattered
input.publishedContext: Fighter’s source-owned aggregate report now separates fight starts, terminal results and observed active gameplay from tab visits. A deliberate same-tab Quick Fight replay has its own definition. Settings offers returning-browser recognition as a separate choice, off by default; the reviewed release includes immediate revocation when persistent storage fails. Custom UTC windows and collection boundaries are visible in Woodhouse.

input.name: SHOALSHOT
input.job: Read the water and land a catch
tasks: Read what happened after the attempt
input.proof: A real handheld session and its recovery path
input.publishedContext: Ten non-species achievement cards now carry original front artwork, joined by earned-card receipts and an ordered reveal after a catch. Two new authored encounter patterns and launcher-specific fire signatures landed in the same window. The multi-tab save-revert repair has shipped; the remaining task is the project's final acceptance reconciliation, not the fix.

input.name: Protocol 11
input.job: Play a readable round with real stakes in the game
tasks: Join and finish a private room
input.proof: A real play-through on the relevant client or clients
input.publishedContext: An illegal desktop drop now refuses visibly instead of silently doing nothing: the destination answers with a marked refusal, ownership and the turn stay unchanged, and a legal drop still works. The same delivery reworked Wild placement and hand sorting, gave Journey stages distinct configurations, and corrected the production mix on three campaign films. The climax, decision short and rival-threat short are public with a press page and source records, and Woodhouse keeps an account-free download of the pack.

input.publishedContext: The public cabinet lists Bubbles, Fighter, Protocol 11 and a shared-characters collection, and its card pages open without an account. Signing in runs through Discord, a one-use email link or a passkey; member albums and serials stay private to the person who opened them.
